_comment: Copyright lines for libraries whose licence text is an SPDX template (MIT, BSD-2/3, ISC) and whose artifact carries no LICENSE file to read one from. Key: uniqueId, or group:prefix* . Each value is copied from the project's own LICENSE file (source noted in _sources). See README.md and docs/oss-licences.md §1.1.

_sources.androidx.camera:camera-core: its POM declares Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause, but the AAR's only LICENSE.txt is Apache-2.0. The BSD-3 half is libyuv, statically linked into jni/*/libimage_processing_util_jni.so: its JNI entry points mirror libyuv's APIs (nativeConvertAndroid420ToABGR = Android420ToABGR, nativeRotateYUV = I420Rotate) and it imports getauxval, libyuv's ARM CPU-feature probe (checked 1.6.2, 2026-10-24). Line from chromium.googlesource.com/libyuv/libyuv LICENSE
